run_reverb_benchmark: run the reverb dataset benchmark to measure replay server performance with different batch and prefetch sizes
create_replay_tables: create reverb replay tables with uniform sampling and FIFO removal for an environment spec
create_adder: create an NStepTransitionAdder connected to a reverb client for inserting transitions into replay
benchmark_dataset_throughput: benchmark reverb dataset throughput by iterating over batches with varying batch sizes and prefetch settings
review_make_replay_tables: review the make_replay_tables function to understand how reverb tables are configured with selectors and rate limiters
